title: Ruins Collapse
next_chapter_hook: Just as Chen Ji thought the worst had passed, a familiar aura at the end of the collapsing passage made his pupils constrict—the people of the Holy Sect were closing in.

text.content:
Celestial spiritual energy surged like a violent tsunami within the ruins. Chen Ji knelt on one knee, veins bulging on his forehead, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea trembling violently—the inheritance power flooding into his body far exceeded what he could endure.

"Crap... why is this inheritance so tyrannical?" He gritted his teeth, feeling his meridians crying out in unbearable protest. The phantom formed by Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul materialized beside him, his expression equally grave: "Chen Xuan sealed away too many things back then... the price for triggering the mechanism... far exceeded our estimates."

dialogue.content: "Hey! Waste of space, can you even do this?" Ye Qing's voice came from nearby, demonic path mist swirling around her but unable to fully block the violent spiritual energy fluctuations. While steadying herself, she shouted at Chen Ji, "This crappy place is about to collapse—did you get the stuff or not?"

text.content:
Chen Ji took a deep breath, enduring the excruciating pain of his meridians tearing as he slowly stood up. His right hand trembled slightly, yet clasped within it was an ancient, simple jade slip—the core object of the inheritance. However, before he could examine it closely, the ground beneath his feet violently shook.

"Crack—"

A fissure spread from beneath Chen Ji's feet, rapidly covering the entire stone chamber like a spider's web. The ceiling above began shedding fragments of stone, stirring up clouds of dust.

dialogue.content: "Got it." A strained smile tugged at Chen Ji's lips. "Just that the price was a bit... over budget." He tucked the jade slip into his chest, scanning his surroundings. "Ye Qing, the left passage—can we make it through?"
"废话！不走等死吗？"夜清一把拽住陈机的手腕，魔道真气在二人之间形成一层薄薄的护罩，"别磨蹭，跟紧我！要是被埋在这破地方，我做鬼也不会放过你！"

text.content: The two sprinted toward the left passage, behind them an endlessly collapsing stone chamber. In the dark corridor, only the faint warmth from Ye Qing's palm proved this wasn't an illusion. After running for about half a tea's time, a fork suddenly appeared ahead—the left passage blazed with lantern light, shadowy figures vaguely visible; the right passage was pitch black, yet carried the distant sound of flowing water.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji paused briefly at the fork, the collapsing sounds growing ever closer behind him. The well-lit left passage seemed safe, but Ye Qing frowned—the auras of those figures were somewhat strange. The pitch-black right passage, though unknown, had produced a faint resonance with the Tianji Record Fragment.

choices.description: The faint resonance of the Tianji Record hints that the right passage might hold a turning point—though dark and unknown, it feels more reassuring than those eerie silhouettes.
choices.risk_hint: The unknown lurking in darkness is unsettling
choices.process_label: 陈机拉着夜清钻入黑暗

text.content: Without a word, Chen Ji pulled Ye Qing into the right passage. His sudden action left her momentarily stunned, but she quickly responded, demonic true qi forming a thin shield around them both. In the darkness, the faint sound of flowing water grew clearer. "Hey, are you sure this path is safe?" she asked in a low voice, her tone sharp yet hiding an inexplicable dependence.

choices.text: Risk taking the left path toward the lights
choices.description: Bright lights suggest a possible exit, and more people might help escape the collapsing area faster. Though those silhouettes feel eerie, it's better than being trapped and dying in darkness.

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated briefly, but ultimately decided to dash toward the well-lit left passage. Ye Qing wanted to speak but held back, following after him. When the two rushed out of the passage, their vision suddenly opened up—however, what they saw was a group of figures in silver-white robes with sacred emblems embroidered on their chests. "Crap, it's the Holy Sect!" Ye Qing cursed under her breath, her expression instantly darkening.

Just as the two stepped into the right passage about a hundred zhang, a deafening roar echoed from behind, followed by endless collapsing sounds. Those well-lit silhouettes seemed caught in the catastrophe too, their screams and shouts intermingling, hauntingly clear in the darkness.

"Lucky we didn't go that way..." Ye Qing glanced back with lingering fear, but at that moment her foot slipped—she stepped on a patch of slippery moss, her whole body pitching forward.

dialogue.content: "Ah—!" Chen Ji instinctively reached out to catch her, but Ye Qing's momentum caused him to stumble. They tumbled together, ending up in an extremely awkward tangled heap. Her lips were nearly brushing his earlobe, her breath warm. "Y-you, get off me!" she hissed quietly, her face flushing an unnatural shade of red.

text.content:
Chen Ji managed to steady himself, supporting himself against the wall as he stood, while pretending to calmly adjust his clothes: "Cough, Holy Sect Lady, is this... your way of repaying a debt with your body? I'm truly honored."

"Shut up!" Ye Qing erupted in furious embarrassment, slapping her palm against his chest. "If you speak another word, I'll make sure you stay here forever!"

Just then, low growls suddenly echoed from the darkness ahead, a foul, pungent smell rushing toward them. The two exchanged a serious glance, their expressions turning grave.

dialogue.content: "It's a demon beast." Ye Qing's expression instantly regained composure, demonic true qi gathering in her palm. "By its aura, it seems to be around second-order superior rank... quite a few of them. What do we do, fight or run?"

choice.prompt: In the darkness, the roars of the demonic beasts drew ever closer, the fetid stench almost unbearable. The Tianji Record Fragment in Chen Ji's possession grew faintly warm, as if hinting at something. Ye Qing had already prepared for battle, awaiting only Chen Ji's decision.

choices.text: Outsmart them—use tactics to split the beast horde
choices.description: Use Ye Qing's Demonic Path mist to create decoys, luring the beast horde in different directions while the two slip through the gaps. Lower risk, but requires precise coordination.

text.content: Chen Ji whispered rapidly in Ye Qing's ear. She froze momentarily, then a glimmer of admiration flickered in her eyes: "How did you come up with such a cunning trick?" Without hesitation, she began condensing the Demonic Path mist, creating decoys on both sides of the passage that raced off in opposite directions. The demonic beasts predictably took the bait, splitting into two groups to pursue.

choices.text: Break through by force—cut a bloody path through
choices.description: To hell with the beasts! While they're not fully encircled, let's charge through! We have the Inheritance Jade Slip anyway—killing them might net us some demon cores.
choices.risk_hint: Chen Ji's meridians are unstable, severely compromising his combat capability

text.content: No sooner had the words left his mouth than Chen Ji surged forward. Ye Qing couldn't stop him and could only follow. A beast lunged directly at his face—Chen Ji dodged sideways, landing a palm strike on its neck. But an unexpected wave of dizziness overwhelmed him, and the residual inheritance power in his meridians began to violently backlash.

Yet the moment Chen Ji's palm connected, the unexpected occurred. The beast let out a凄厉 shriek, its entire body convulsing as诡异的 black blood poured from all seven orifices. "This..." Chen Ji stood frozen—he had exerted merely thirty percent of his strength. How could it possibly result in an instant kill? Ye Qing rushed forward to examine, her complexion dramatically shifting: "This beast has a binding seal inside! It was cultivated by someone—if it dies, its master will know!"

dialogue.content: "Someone cultivated this?" Chen Ji's brow furrowed tightly as his mind raced through possibilities. The Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea quivered subtly, projecting a blurry vision—a group draped in silver-white robes advancing toward the ruins' depths. Silver-white robes... the Holy Sect! "No good!" Chen Ji jerked his head up. "This beast is a Holy Sect scout! They've surrounded the ruins!" Ye Qing's pupils contracted sharply: "Damn it... but where do we go? Wolves ahead, tigers behind!"

text.content: Chen Ji surveyed his surroundings when a faintly glowing crack caught his attention at the channel's end—a fissure concealed by vines, nearly imperceptible without the Tianji Record Fragment's resonance. "That way!" he shouted, pointing at the fissure. "It's our escape route!" Ye Qing glanced toward the indicated spot, hesitation flickering across her face: "Those vines are at least a millennium old, likely harboring traps or guardian beasts..." "Do you have a better choice?" Chen Ji forced a bitter smile. "If the Holy Sect discovers us, how can we possibly survive?"

choice.prompt: The Holy Sect's encirclement tightened as the ruins' collapse accelerated. That vine-covered fissure represented both their sole chance of survival and the potential start of another crisis. Ye Qing fixed her gaze on Chen Ji, awaiting his final decision.

choices.text: Take the gamble—enter the vine fissure
choices.description: Since the Tianji Record points to this path, trust in fate. The Holy Sect's net is closing in—rather than wait for death, actively seek a way out.
choices.risk_hint: The unknown lurking within the vines breeds unease

text.content: Chen Ji grabbed Ye Qing's wrist and charged toward the fissure. The vines surged violently as the two approached, wrapping around them like living things. Ye Qing冷哼一声, her Demonic Path True Qi manifesting as blades that severed every vine that drew near. "Stop hesitating! Get inside!" she urged, positioning herself to cover their retreat against the relentless tendrils.

choices.text: Set up traps to delay the Holy Sect
choices.description: Since we can't avoid them, why not use the ruins' collapse and the beast corpses to set traps? Let the Holy Sect deal with their own troubles, buying ourselves time to escape.
choices.risk_hint: may be discovered by the Holy Sect

text.content: Chen Ji quickly scanned his surroundings, already sketching out a rough plan in his mind. He dragged the corpse of the slain demon beast around the corner of the passage, then took out several spirit stones from his embrace and set up the simplest restriction formation around the area. "This formation can hold for at most half a cup of tea's time, but that's enough to throw the Holy Sect's people into chaos." He brushed the dust off his hands. "Let's go, before they can react."

However, just as the two of them slipped through the vine crack, a thunderous roar erupted from behind them. A blinding silver light burst from the body of the dead demon beast, and the entire ruins shook violently under the force of this power.

"What... what is that?!" Ye Qing cried out in alarm.

Chen Ji's face turned ashen: "That's the Holy Sect's tracking prohibition... they've detonated all the power within this demon beast's body! The collapse of the entire ruins has accelerated tenfold!"

dialogue.content:
"You bringer of bad luck!" Ye Qing stomped her foot in anger, yet still tightly gripped Chen Ji's hand. "What do we do now? We don't know where the path ahead leads, and the way back is blocked!"

Chen Ji gritted his teeth, the Tianji Record Fragment pulsing frantically in his Mental Sea. The blurry images told him a cruel truth—the crack ahead led to an underground dark river, which might be the only exit, but the currents were torrential, and the slightest misstep would result in drowning.

text.content:
The crack grew narrower, the vines wound tighter, as if to completely devour the two of them in this darkness. Chen Ji felt his breathing becoming difficult, and the excruciating pain in his meridians was intensifying.

Just then, a faint glimmer appeared ahead.

"There's light!" Ye Qing exclaimed. "The exit is right ahead!"

The two of them fought with all their strength toward that light, behind them the ruins were constantly collapsing, and the vines chased them relentlessly. Ye Qing's Demonic Path True Qi was nearly exhausted, and Chen Ji's legs were starting to give out.

dialogue.content:
Finally, the two tumbled out of the crack and crashed heavily onto a damp rock. Above them was a narrow fissure, moonlight pouring in through it. Not far away, the roar of torrential water resounded—that was the underground dark river.

"Cough..." Chen Ji struggled to sit up, looking at the crack still constantly collapsing, a bitter smile tugging at his lips. "Seems like heaven isn't ready to take us yet."

Ye Qing leaned against a rock, gasping for breath, yet still glaring at him: "Next time you say something like that, I'll throw you into the dark river to feed the fish!"

text.content:
Just as Chen Ji was about to retort, the Tianji Record Fragment suddenly trembled violently. He closed his eyes, and a blurry image formed in his mind—at the fissure where moonlight poured in, several figures in silver-white robes had appeared.

The Holy Sect's people... had actually found this place so quickly?

"Ye Qing." Chen Ji's voice suddenly turned low. "Do you trust me?"

Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then snorted coldly: "What schemes are you hatching now?"

"The dark river." Chen Ji opened his eyes, his gaze burning with determination. "We only have one chance."

Under the moonlight, those silver-white figures slowly approached. The leader possessed a deep aura, clearly a cultivator of no small strength. Chen Ji and Ye Qing exchanged a glance, no words needed, and simultaneously leaped into the torrential dark river.

The icy water instantly engulfed the two of them, the violent current carrying them rushing toward unknown depths.

Just as consciousness was about to be swallowed by darkness, an image flashed through Chen Ji's mind—those eyes, so identical to Chen Nian's, were gazing with interest through some kind of prohibition at the direction he was about to escape.

Chen Ji struggled to stay conscious in the torrential current, yet could not ignore that lingering image in his mind.

Those eyes... that meaningful smile...

His heart clenched tightly.

Was it Chen Nian? Or someone connected to her? Why would they appear in this secret realm thousands of miles away? How did they know his movements so precisely?

The river roared, Chen Ji's thoughts were abruptly severed. In the last moment before unconsciousness, he silently made a note of this debt in his heart—no matter who that person was, he would find the answer.

And at this moment, in some distant corner of the secret realm, a figure chuckled lightly: "Interesting... this game is far more entertaining than I imagined."
